text:
maria-sales: Heads-up — revops published an updated rate card (RC-2026-03) this morning. It includes new commit tiers and a streamlined approval path for >$50k ARR deals. Can we confirm how this applies to in-flight POCs?

sophie-revops: Thanks for flagging. Effective date is 2026-04-01. For active POCs started before that date we can either 1) honor the signed pricing, or 2) apply the new rate card if the AE requests a re-quote. No automatic switches.

maria-sales: Copy. We have a POC with Greenbyte that signed a non-binding LOI in Feb. They want the lower commit discounts from the new card — do they need deal desk approval?

zach-dealdesk: @maria-sales if it's a change that increases discount depth or extends credit terms, yes we need formal deal desk approval. Please submit the "ratecard-exception" form (internal link: https://redwood/rd/dealdesk/form). Include the original LOI and target commit.

olga-ae: Quick Q — can commit credits be stacked with promo coupon codes? Customer asks if they can use both.

sophie-revops: Short answer: no stacking by default. We allow one commercial concession + standard commit tier. If you're proposing stacking, route through @zach-dealdesk and include margin impact.

jamal-legal: Also flagging: the updated rate card references a new data processing addendum (DPA) clause for dedicated/private deployments. If a customer requires SOC2 language modifications, legal needs to review any addendum changes before we accept in an MSA.

maria-sales: Noted. Greenbyte asked about SOC2 scoping for the POC (shared hosted). I'll loop legal and ask for a quick review.

zach-dealdesk: For the approval path: 1) AE completes form, 2) revops verifies matrix & margin, 3) deal desk approves or escalates to CRO for >$200k TCV. Typical SLA: 48 hours. If you need faster ping me in-thread + :phone:.

ratecard-bot: Automated note: RC-2026-03 published by sophie-revops at 2026-03-29T09:12Z. Changelog: new commit bands, clarified promo stacking, added DPA reference.

olga-ae: Thanks — submitting the form now for Greenbyte with the LOI attached. Will tag @zach-dealdesk once submitted.

maria-sales: One operational question: when we re-quote under new card, do we keep the same quote ID or issue a fresh one?

sophie-revops: Issue a fresh quote ID referencing the original LOI in the notes. That preserves audit trail for finance and renewals.

zach-dealdesk: Got it. @olga-ae after you submit, I'll triage and aim to get a decision today. :thumbsup:

maria-sales: Awesome — appreciate the quick turn.

ratecard-bot: Reminder: Deal desk approval required for any manual discounting outside published rate card.
